entities.summary: Anton Bernolák's first codification (1787), Ján Kollár's pan-Slavic ideas, and Ľudovít Štúr's definitive codification of standard Slovak (1843) based on Central Slovak dialects. The 1848 Slovak National Council and military campaign for autonomy within Hungary.
